items.title: Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami could book their 2026 MLS Cup playoff ticket against NYCFC
items.description:
Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami can clinch a 2026 MLS Cup playoff berth with a win over New York City FC. 
Lionel Messi and Inter Miami have a chance to secure their place in the 2026 MLS Cup playoffs when they host New York City FC. The Herons enter the match in strong form, knowing that a victory would be enough to make the postseason official with the regular season entering its final stretch.



Inter Miami arrive second in the Eastern Conference with 49 points from 28 matches, behind league-leading Nashville SC, who have 63. A win against NYCFC would clinch a playoff spot for Miami, while other results could also seal it if the game ends in a draw.



Miami are coming off a 4-0 rout of D.C. United, a match in which both Messi and Luis Suárez scored braces. Inter Miami will lean on their explosive attack, led by Messi, who has 23 goals and 11 assists this season, while Suárez has 15 goals.



NYCFC, meanwhile, arrive in a very different situation. The visitors sit tenth in the Eastern Conference with 33 points and need results to keep their playoff hopes alive. They are coming off a 2-1 loss to Chicago Fire, which extended their winless run to three matches and has worsened the situation for Pascal Jansen’s side.




Midweek fútbol awaits. 🫡⚽️ #MIAvNYCFC🎟️ https://t.co/41vfglG4PF pic.twitter.com/JEscTtiGRd— Inter Miami CF (@InterMiamiCF) October 12, 2026




Inter Miami dealing with one absence



Inter Miami will be without midfielder Yannick Bright for the match against NYCFC, as he is the club’s only confirmed absence. Bright has been sidelined with a foot injury since coming off after 40 minutes against Columbus Crew. Since he was unable to return to training in time, he was ruled out of the 4-0 win over D.C. United, and he remains unavailable for Wednesday’s showdown at Nu Stadium.


        


There is better news on the injury front for Messi and company, as Facundo Mura returns to the squad. The defender had been dealing with an ankle sprain since he was substituted in the 71st minute against Columbus, and he is back in the matchday group for the potential playoff-clinching game.



With the playoffs within reach, Inter Miami have a chance to take a big step toward the postseason at home, backed by an in-form attack and a squad that is nearly at full strength. Messi and Suárez will once again be the ones to watch, while NYCFC will try to keep their own playoff hopes alive and spoil the night in Miami.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo faces fresh UEFA Champions League goalscoring record threat as Harry Kane matches Robert Lewandowski and Ruud van Nistelrooy
items.description:
The Bayern Munich striker's latest European performance has brought him closer to Ronaldo's long-standing record, setting up an intriguing challenge as the 2026-27 campaign unfolds. 
Cristiano Ronaldo has another reason to keep an eye on the UEFA Champions League, with Harry Kane matching the remarkable nine-game goalscoring streaks achieved by Robert Lewandowski and Ruud van Nistelrooy. The Bayern Munich striker’s latest European performance has brought him closer to Ronaldo’s long-standing record, setting up an intriguing challenge as the 2026-27 campaign unfolds.



Kane reached the milestone during Bayern‘s dramatic 3-3 draw against Viking on Tuesday, October 13, scoring twice to help his team recover from a difficult start. Despite the Englishman’s impressive achievement, one of football’s greatest goalscorers remains ahead of him.



The Bundesliga champion endured a frustrating evening in Norway after Viking raced into a surprising 2-0 lead at Lyse Arena. Gianni Stensness opened the scoring in the second minute before Peter Christiansen doubled the home side’s advantage shortly before half-time.



The Englishman responded after the break, converting a penalty in the 54th minute before heading home a Joshua Kimmich cross six minutes later to make it 2-2. Luis Díaz subsequently put Bayern ahead, but Michael Olise’s red card in the 74th minute left the visitors with 10 men, allowing Kristoffer Haugen to equalize in the 90th minute.









Although the Bavarians failed to secure all three points, Kane‘s brace ensured that his extraordinary Champions League scoring streak continued. The 33-year-old has now scored in nine consecutive appearances in Europe’s premier club competition, placing him among an exclusive group of forwards.



Lewandowski and Van Nistelrooy reached the same milestone



Kane’s achievement also places him alongside two other celebrated strikers who enjoyed extraordinary consistency in Europe. Ruud van Nistelrooy scored in nine consecutive Champions League matches for Manchester United in 2002-03, while Lewandowski achieved the same feat twice with Bayern Munich.



The Polish striker’s runs came between September 2019 and August 2020, and again between November 2020 and November 2021. Lewandowski remains the only player to have recorded the nine-game sequence on two separate occasions, underlining his sustained excellence at the highest level.



Robert Lewandowski of FC Bayern Muenchen celebrates after scoring



According to UEFA, Kane became the fourth player to score in nine successive matches in the competition, joining Ronaldo, Van Nistelrooy and Lewandowski. His latest brace has therefore put him in elite company while keeping the record-holder firmly within reach.



How many goals to reach Ronaldo’s record?



The next milestone Kane is chasing belongs to Ronaldo, who scored in 11 consecutive Champions League matches during his time at Real Madrid in 2017 and 2018. The Portuguese superstar’s run began with two goals in Madrid’s 4-1 victory over Juventus in the 2017 final and continued throughout the following season’s group stage and knockout rounds.



GoalsPlayerClubSeason11Cristiano RonaldoReal Madrid2017–189Ruud van NistelrooyManchester United2002–039Robert LewandowskiBayern Munich2019–209Robert LewandowskiBayern Munich2020–219Harry KaneBayern Munich2026–present8Cristiano RonaldoReal Madrid2013–14



The five-time Ballon d’Or winner scored in all six group-stage matches before finding the net in both legs of Madrid’s round-of-16 tie against Paris Saint-Germain and both legs of their quarter-final against Juventus. He scored 17 goals across the 11-match sequence, establishing a benchmark that has remained unbeaten.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Real Madrid celebrating.



Kane now needs to score in two more consecutive Champions League appearances to equal Ronaldo’s record. Another goal beyond that would give the Bayern forward sole possession of the mark, provided he maintains his streak without interruption.



9 – Only Cristiano Ronaldo in April 2018 (11) has enjoyed a longer run of successive games with a goal in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League than Harry Kane’s ongoing run of nine.

items.title: Harry Kane joins Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi among the Champions League’s all-time top 10 scorers
items.description:
Harry Kane scored a brace against Viking to join Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi in the Champions League’s all-time top 10 scorers. 
Harry Kane has joined an elite company in the Champions League record books. The Bayern Munich striker has entered the competition’s all-time top 10 scorers, a list headed by Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi, after another goal-scoring night in Europe.



Kane scored a brace in Bayern’s 3-3 draw at Viking, lifting his Champions League tally from 55 to 57 goals. The brace puts him level with Thomas Muller in tenth place and ahead of Mohamed Salah and Thierry Henry.



The 33-year-old has found a second wind in the competition since moving to Bayern in 2023. He scored 21 goals in 32 Champions League appearances for Tottenham, and with the two against Viking he now has 36 in 40 games for the Bavarians.



Kane is also the highest-scoring English player in Champions League history, and he holds the record for most goals by an English player in a single campaign, with 14 in 2025/26. Even so, Ronaldo and Messi remain far ahead at the top.




Tonight’s player of the match 🏆 pic.twitter.com/lfMl4CuMCL— FC Bayern (@FCBayernEN) October 13, 2026




The Portuguese superstar leads with 141 goals, while the Argentine legend is second on 129, two totals that put Kane’s progress in perspective. Still, reaching the top 10 at this stage of his career shows how consistently the Englishman has delivered on Europe’s biggest stage.


        


Champions League all-time top 10 scorers



The list is led by Ronaldo and Messi, the only two players above 120 goals, followed by Robert Lewandowski, who is clear in third place with 109. Kylian Mbappe is level with Raul on 71 goals, while Erling Haaland, who is still chasing the leaders, shares 59 with Andriy Shevchenko.



PlayerGoalsCristiano Ronaldo141Lionel Messi129Robert Lewandowski109Karim Benzema90Raul71Kylian Mbappe71Ruud van Nistelrooy60Andriy Shevchenko59Erling Haaland59Harry Kane57Thomas Muller57



With the top four now outside the Champions League, the door is open for the players still active in Europe to climb the list. Ronaldo and Benzema find themselves in the Saudi Pro League with Al Nassr and Al Hilal respectively, while Lewandowski joined Chicago Fire to face Messi’s Inter Miami in MLS.



That leaves Mbappe, Haaland and Kane as the main contenders to chase them down. Mbappe, who is on 71 goals, needs 20 more to pass Benzema in fourth place, while Haaland and Kane, on 59 and 57, will need more time to close the gap on the leaders.

items.description:
Take a look at the confirmed lineups for Atletico Madrid vs Manchester United in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League. Atletico Madrid and Manchester United meet in the 2026-27 Champions League with both clubs looking to steady their European campaigns.
Atletico Madrid come into this one off a 1-2 loss to Liverpool on September 9, a result that leaves Diego Simeone searching for a response at home.
Manchester United, by contrast, arrive in form after a 4-0 win over Sabah FK on September 10, giving Michael Carrick’s side some momentum heading into Spain.
Atletico Madrid confirmed lineup
Simeone sets up in his familiar 4-4-2, with Hancko, Romero, Pubill and Grimaldo forming the back line in front of Oblak. Cardoso and Llorente anchor the midfield alongside Baena and Giuliano Simeone, giving the side defensive cover and width on both flanks. Julian Alvarez partners Lee Kang-in up top, a pairing built to combine quick combinations with direct running in behind. There are no absences listed for Atletico Madrid, so Simeone can pick from a full squad for this one.
Atletico Madrid confirmed starting XI (4-4-2): Jan Oblak, David Hancko, Cristian Romero, Marcos Llorente, Alex Grimaldo, Alex Baena, Pablo Barrios, Giuliano Simeone, Johnny Cardoso, Julian Alvarez, Lee Kang-in. Coach: Diego Simeone.
Manchester United confirmed lineup
Carrick lines Manchester United up in a 4-2-3-1, with Martinez, Yoro, Dalot and Maguire protecting Lammens in goal. Tielemans and Andrey Santos sit as the double pivot, tasked with shielding the back four and feeding the attacking trio of Bruno Fernandes, Mbeumo and Rashford. Cunha leads the line as the central striker, with the front four expected to rotate positions to create overloads. No absences are listed for Manchester United, meaning Carrick has his first-choice group available for the trip to Madrid.

items.title: Why is Raphinha not playing for Barcelona vs Galatasaray in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
items.description:
The Brazilian forward’s absence comes at an inconvenient time for the Catalan side, which has made a perfect start to the season and will be looking to maintain its momentum in Europe. 
Raphinha will miss Barcelona’s crucial UEFA Champions League meeting with Galatasaray as Hansi Flick prepares his team for a demanding trip to Istanbul. The Brazilian forward’s absence comes at an inconvenient time for the Catalan side, which has made a perfect start to the season and will be looking to maintain its momentum in Europe.



Barcelona travel to RAMS Park on Tuesday, October 13, after winning all eight of their opening La Liga matches and beating Feyenoord 5-1 in their Champions League opener. Galatasaray, meanwhile, needs a positive result after losing 3-1 to Sporting CP in its first European fixture.



Flick’s side has been one of the most impressive teams in Europe during the opening weeks of the campaign. Barcelona’s latest 3-0 victory over Getafe extended its winning run in La Liga to eight matches, leaving the club with 24 points, 34 goals scored, and seven conceded.



The Catalan side also began its European campaign emphatically, defeating Feyenoord 5-1 at Camp Nou on September 9. Raphinha scored twice in that match, underscoring the attacking threat the Blaugrana will miss against Galatasaray.









Despite his absence, Flick still has several quality options available in the final third. Gabriel Jesus is expected to lead the attack, with Lamine Yamal and Anthony Gordon providing width and creativity, while Pedri and Rodri will be important to Barcelona’s efforts to control possession.



Why is Raphinha missing against Galatasaray?



Raphinha is unavailable due to a muscle injury in the back of his right thigh sustained while playing for Brazil during the international break. He was substituted at half-time during Brazil’s 4-2 friendly victory over Australia on September 29 before returning to Barcelona for medical examinations.



The initial findings offered some encouragement because they did not indicate a major muscle tear. However, Barcelona remained cautious because Raphinha had suffered three muscle injuries during the previous season, raising concerns about the risk of another setback if he returned too soon.



Raphinha of FC Barcelona Interacts with Hansi Flick, Manager of FC Barcelona



Flick explained the club’s approach ahead of the Galatasaray fixture. “The picture showed something, but it’s not a big injury,” the Barcelona manager said, according to The Athletic. He added: “It’s something we have to take care of because last season he had three injuries there. He won’t be eligible tomorrow, nor in Istanbul either.”



Why Raphinha missed Getafe and Galatasaray



Barcelona’s schedule following the international break left little time for Raphinha to complete his recovery. He was unavailable for the La Liga match against Getafe on October 10 and has also been ruled out of the Champions League trip to Galatasaray on October 13. The two absences are part of the same recovery period rather than separate injury setbacks.



Barcelona’s priority is to ensure that the Brazilian can return to full training without aggravating the problem. His absence is significant because Raphinha has become an important part of Flick’s attacking system. His pressing, movement and ability to create chances give Barcelona an additional dimension, particularly in matches when opponents defend deep.



Raphinha of FC Barcelona celebrates scoring



When could Raphinha return?



Raphinha’s next possible appearances depend on how quickly he progresses through rehabilitation and resumes full training. Barcelona faces Real Betis on October 17, followed by a Champions League meeting with Paris Saint-Germain on October 20 and El Clasico against Real Madrid on October 25.



The PSG fixture has emerged as a potential target for his return, but it should not be treated as a confirmed comeback date. Barcelona president Joan Laporta reportedly offered encouragement when discussing the winger’s recovery, saying: “The doctors say he’ll be available for the match in Paris.”



That assessment suggests the club is hopeful Raphinha will be ready for the trip to France. His availability will ultimately depend on his medical progress and whether he can return to training without discomfort.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al-Nassr make urgent request ahead of Al-Ahli clash in Saudi Pro League as travel issue emerges
items.description:
With the match scheduled for Thursday, October 15, uncertainty surrounding the team’s travel plans has raised questions about whether the high-profile encounter can proceed as planned. 
Cristiano Ronaldo and Al-Nassr face an unexpected challenge ahead of one of the Saudi Pro League’s most anticipated fixtures, with the club seeking urgent changes to its preparations for the upcoming clash against Al-Ahli. With the match scheduled for Thursday, October 15, uncertainty surrounding the team’s travel plans has raised questions about whether the high-profile encounter can proceed as planned.



The situation has developed following a demanding week for Al-Nassr, which played in continental competition in Riyadh before turning its attention to a crucial domestic fixture in Jeddah. The club is now waiting for a decision that could significantly affect its preparation and recovery time.



Ronaldo’s side has formally requested that the Saudi Pro League postpone its match against Al-Ahli, according to reports from Rotana Sport and other Saudi media outlets. The fixture is scheduled for Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 9 p.m. local time in Jeddah, but the club has yet to receive confirmation that the request will be accepted.



The uncertainty has also affected the team’s immediate plans. According to reports attributed to Ali Alabdallah and other accounts covering the club, Al-Nassr had not departed Riyadh while awaiting further developments, with its delegation reportedly prepared to travel if the match remained on schedule.



🚨 CRISTIANO RONALDO SCORES GOAL NUMBER 981 A TURN AND VOLLEY 🥶 pic.twitter.com/lk9ReEtkJh— Baller HQ (@FootballerHQ) October 12, 2026 



The travel problem behind the postponement request



The main issue is disruption to air travel from Riyadh, which could force Al-Nassr to make an approximately 11-hour journey by road to Jeddah. Such a trip would leave the players with less time to recover and prepare for a match that carries significant implications for the league standings.



The problem comes after an exhausting continental fixture on Monday, October 12. Al-Nassr’s 3-1 AFC Champions League Elite victory over Uzbekistan’s Neftchi Fergana was reportedly delayed by around an hour following a security alert in Riyadh linked to a missile threat attributed to Houthi forces.



The alert prompted a Civil Defense warning and disrupted the evening’s preparations. The 41-year-old veteran featured in the victory, but the late finish and subsequent travel uncertainty have complicated the club’s preparations for its next match.



Cristiano Ronaldo of team Al Nassr celebrates scoring



Why the Al-Ahli clash matters



The encounter is widely regarded as one of the Saudi Pro League’s major fixtures, often described as a clasico because of the stature of the two clubs. Al-Nassr sits third with 19 points from eight matches, while Al-Ahli occupies sixth place with 15 points.



Both clubs have ambitions of challenging near the top of the table, making the timing of the fixture particularly important. Al-Nassr will want to maintain its momentum after the continental victory, while Al-Ahli will look to take advantage of playing at home.



A long journey immediately before the match could affect Al-Nassr’s energy levels and preparation. The club’s request therefore raises a wider question about how leagues should respond when exceptional circumstances interfere with player recovery and scheduled travel.

items.title: Lionel Messi’s attendance at the Ballon d’Or gala in London reportedly remains unconfirmed
items.description:
Lionel Messi’s attendance at the Ballon d’Or gala in London remains unconfirmed less than two weeks before the October 26 ceremony. 
Lionel Messi’s presence at the 2026 Ballon d’Or gala in London is still up in the air, with his attendance reportedly yet to be confirmed and no role in the trophy presentation planned for him. The uncertainty comes less than two weeks before the October 26 ceremony, where the eight-time winner is among this year’s nominees.



According to Fabrizio Romano, Messi will not be presenting a trophy to any of the winners, as he has not been invited to do so, and his attendance at the gala has not yet been confirmed. 



The update goes against earlier reports that had placed the Argentine at the center of the night, with some outlets claiming he would attend with his family and even hand the golden trophy to the new winner.



Messi earned his place among the 30 nominees thanks to a campaign that included Inter Miami’s first MLS Cup title in 2025, a season in which he won the Golden Boot with 29 goals and a second straight MVP award.



Lionel Messi #10 of Inter Miami CF lifts the MLS Cup trophy. (Getty Images)



He then led Argentina to the 2026 World Cup final, where he scored eight goals and added four assists before the Albiceleste fell 1-0 to Spain. It is the 17th Ballon d’Or nomination of his career, and whether he ends up in London, and in what role, remains to be seen.


        


Why is the Ballon d’Or being held in London?



Unlike previous editions, which were staged in Paris, the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony will cross the Channel and take place in London for the first time in the award’s history. The change of venue is more than a logistical decision, as it carries a symbolic meaning tied to the origins of the prize itself.



The 70th edition of the award will take place at the London Palladium on October 26, marking the first time the Ballon d’Or is presented in the English capital. The change of venue is a symbolic choice to honor Sir Stanley Matthews, who became the first winner of the prize in 1956.



Matthews, then a Blackpool winger, was 41 when he received the inaugural trophy from France Football, making him one of the most enduring figures in English football history. Seventy years later, the ceremony will leave its usual home in Paris to pay tribute to the man who started the tradition.

items.title: Thibaut Courtois set to extend Real Madrid stay past 2027 after reportedly reaching agreement
items.description:
Thibaut Courtois has been an essential pillar for Real Madrid since joining the club in 2018, and Los Blancos have now reached an agreement in principle to extend his contract beyond June 2027. 
Real Madrid found in Thibaut Courtois one of the most reliable goalkeepers in recent soccer history. Now, the club has reportedly decided to keep him for longer, extending his contract beyond 2027.



In 2018, Real Madrid made a blockbuster move by signing Thibaut Courtois. Despite a highly successful run with Keylor Navas, Los Blancos wanted a smooth transition with the Costa Rican set to leave the club soon.



Courtois lived up to expectations and has become a key player for the club ever since. His current contract expires in June 2027, but according to Fabrizio Romano, it will be extended through the 2027–28 season.



Uncertainty regarding the future of the position



Despite the recent challenges Real Madrid have faced, Thibaut Courtois has remained a vital figure for the Spanish club and is regarded as a crucial element of the squad despite managerial changes.



Thibaut Courtois of Real Madrid acknowledges the fans.



The 34-year-old goalkeeper earns around $17 million per season. His new deal is expected to feature similar terms, but the duration of the extension is what has drawn attention from supporters.


        


With reports indicating that only one year will be added to his current deal, it suggests Real Madrid may be planning for a transition in goal by June 2028, leaving many to wonder who will eventually succeed him in such a critical role.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo scores 981st career goal: Can he reach the 1,000-goal mark before 2027?
items.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo keeps adding goals to his career. Now that he has scored the 981st goal in his tally, could he reach the 1,000-goal mark before the year ends? 
Cristiano Ronaldo keeps scoring, and the 1,000-goal mark seems more reachable than ever. However, after netting the 981st goal of his career, many are wondering whether he could reach that historic milestone before 2027.



On Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite, Cristiano Ronaldo scored Al Nassr‘s second goal against Uzbekistan’s Neftchi Fergana—marking the 981st goal of his career.



He is now just 19 goals away from the 1,000-goal threshold, and at his current pace, he could potentially reach the milestone before the new year begins.



Road to 1,000 goals: Mathematical breakdown for Cristiano Ronaldo



A total of 19 goals is all that Cristiano Ronaldo needs to hit 1,000 career goals. Fortunately, he has plenty of fixtures remaining before the year ends to try to reach that mark by December.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr.



Al Nassr has 15 matches remaining on their schedule this year. Combined with international duty for Portugal—where he is set to return in November—he will have two additional games to build on his tally.


        


If everything goes as expected, he will have 17 matches available. While he may not feature in every single one, assuming full availability, he would need to score at least a brace in two matches and a single goal in the remaining 15 to hit the 1,000-goal mark before the new year.



Obviously, scoring 19 goals in 17 games would require a monumental effort from Ronaldo. However, even if he falls short, he will still have the first half of 2027 during the remainder of the season to reach and surpass the milestone.



Recent history is not on his side



During the 2025–26 season, Cristiano Ronaldo averaged 0.82 goals per match, a figure well below the scoring rate required to reach the 1,000-goal mark before 2026 concludes.



Nevertheless, his main objective will be to close the gap as much as possible before 2027, reducing the pressure as he enters the second half of the campaign.

items.title: Why was Al Nassr vs Neftchi Fergana kickoff delayed at 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite?
items.description:
The game between Al Nassr and Neftchi Fergana in Matchday 2 of the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite suffered a delay in the kickoff time due to problems in Riyadh. 
The AFC Champions League Elite fixture between Al Nassr and Neftchi Fergana at Al-Awwal Park in Riyadh was officially postponed following heightened security alerts in the Saudi Arabian capital. Match officials halted pre-game preparations after regional air defense activity and a missile strike in the wider Riyadh metropolitan area triggered emergency security protocols surrounding the stadium, as reported by Ryan Rozbiani.



In response to the safety advisory, the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) and local organizers intervened to suspend stadium operations, prioritizing the well-being of players, coaching staff, and spectators. Uzbek side Neftchi Fergana and their traveling delegation, who had landed in Riyadh via charter flight ahead of the contest, remained in safe isolation at their hotel while awaiting formal updates from tournament officials.



Competition administrators are currently reviewing logistical options to determine when the group stage encounter will be played. Potential solutions under discussion between football authorities and both clubs include rescheduling the fixture for a later date or relocating the match to a neutral venue to ensure it can be conducted safely.



Will the game be played?



According to authorities, the game has been delayed due to missile strikes targeting Riyadh. The match was scheduled to be played at Al-Awwal Park, located in the capital city.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr.



Reports indicate that kickoff initially suffered a 30-minute delay, but that revised time has already passed. Announcements over the stadium public address system instructed fans inside the venue to remain calm, stay in their seats, and await further official updates.


        


As of now, The Nassr Tribune reports that the game will start at 10:15 PM Saudi time (3:15 PM ET). Although Al-Awwal Park has not suffered any direct hits, authorities decided to delay it due to any potential problems.

Al Nassr host Uzbekistan's Neftchi Fergana in Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite at Al-Awwal Park, with the primary question surrounding the availability and status of captain Cristiano Ronaldo. 
Al Nassr face a crucial match in the 2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite as they host Uzbekistan’s Neftchi Fergana. The big question remaining is whether Cristiano Ronaldo will play for the Saudi side.



Cristiano Ronaldo will start for Al Nassr on Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite. He participated in his club’s recent Saudi Pro League win over Diriyah Club, opening the scoring in his team’s 3–0 victory.



Head coach Ange Postecoglou recently provided an update on Cristiano Ronaldo’s status, confirming that the striker was set to start against the Uzbek side in a vital encounter for Al Nassr.



Al Nassr’s confirmed lineup



Al Nassr enter this continental clash eager to bounce back following a defeat to Al Ain on opening night. Securing all three points is vital for the Saudi side as they aim to climb out of the bottom of the standings.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr.



Al Nassr confirmed starting XI (4-4-2): Bento Matheus Krepski; Nawaf Boushal, Mohamed Simakan, Íñigo Martínez, Awad Aman; Ângelo Gabriel, Samú Costa, Kingsley Coman; Sadio Mané, João Félix, Cristiano Ronaldo. Coach: Ange Postecoglou.


        


Neftchi Fergana’s confirmed lineup



As for Neftchi Fergana, they earned a win on Matchday 1 and currently occupy a playoff spot. While plenty of fixtures remain in the campaign, getting off on the right foot—and potentially claiming a landmark victory on the road against Al Nassr—could prove crucial in their quest to advance to the next round.



Neftchi Fergana confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Botirali Ergashev; Ibrohimkhalil Yuldoshev, Bojan Ciger, Michel Augusto, Anvar G’ofurov, Koffi Kouao; Yan Sasse, Ikromjon Alibaev, Jamshid Iskanderov, Abrorbek Ismoilov; Marcus Forss. Coach: Islombek Ismoilov.

The majority of people involved in the game speak it with a high degree of sophistication. Minor deviations from the familiar, almost imperceptible to outsiders, can set off alarm bells: what’s really going on there? Why isn’t he happy? What’s she hinting at? items.title: Lionel Messi selects soccer’s top 10 future stars: Did any USMNT player make the list?

Lionel Messi remains one of soccer's greatest icons, and as his legendary career enters its final chapter following his international farewell, the Argentine maestro has officially revealed the latest group of top 10 young talents he believes represent the future of the sport. 
Lionel Messi is entering the final years of his illustrious career. As one of soccer’s greatest legends, he possesses a keen eye for talent, and he has now selected 10 future stars who he believes will define the next era of the sport.



In partnership with Adidas—the sportswear giant that has sponsored him for two decades—Messi named his top 10 rising talents across both men’s and women’s soccer, with a USMNT prospect earning a spot on the list.



Among those selected is Zavier Gozo, whom Messi highlighted as a player destined for greatness. The 19-year-old forward currently plays for Crystal Palace and is widely regarded as one of the brightest young talents in the USMNT pipeline.



Lionel Messi’s Complete List of Future Stars



Messi’s selections span both men’s and women’s football, featuring promising talents who are already making their mark for club and country. The well-rounded cohort reinforces the belief that his eye for future stardom remains as sharp as ever.

items.title: Liverpool fans parody Oasis to mock Manchester City over financial ruling
items.description:
British iconic band Oasis, famously fronted by die-hard Manchester City supporters Liam and Noel Gallagher, became the central theme of Liverpool fans' taunts at Anfield following the Premier League's financial ruling against the club. 
During Manchester City’s visit to Anfield, Liverpool fans wasted no time taunting their rivals over the 114 charges against them, using references to iconic British band Oasis to do so.



Liam and Noel Gallagher are arguably the most famous Manchester City supporters. As members of the legendary band Oasis, they became the primary target for Liverpool fans, who used the connection to hit the Citizens with mocking messages about their ongoing legal troubles.



Through several banners and flags, Liverpool fans referenced Oasis songs and modified band logos to criticize Manchester City over the 114 financial charges facing the club.



Oasis-inspired banners at Anfield



With Noel Gallagher present in the stands at Anfield, Liverpool supporters seized the opportunity to target Manchester City over their pending legal charges. Here are some of the banners spotted in the crowd:



        Ver esta publicación en Instagram            Una publicación compartida por Bolavip (@bolavipcom)




“Sham Pain Supernova”: A play on the 1995 hit Champagne Supernova.“& After All, You Really Robbed Us All”: A parody of the iconic line from Wonderwall.“All of Your Stars Are Fading Away”: A direct reference to Stop Crying Your Heart Out.“Look Back in Anger, Shamchester City”: A nod to the 1996 anthem Don’t Look Back in Anger.


        


Unfortunately for Liverpool, the final result was not in their favor. The Reds suffered a 3–0 defeat at home, with Erling Haaland, Jérémy Doku, and Rayan Cherki all finding the net. To make matters worse, Ryan Gravenberch—who replaced the injured Dominik Szoboszlai in the starting lineup—was shown a red card in the second half.



Can Manchester City be stripped of their titles?



Under Premier League regulations, an independent commission holds broad authority to enforce penalties if a club is found guilty of financial breaches, ranging from fines and current points deductions to title revocation. If the charges against Manchester City are ultimately upheld, the league technically possesses the disciplinary power to retrospectively strip them of titles won during the non-compliant seasons.



However, stripping titles would be an unprecedented penalty in English football history and would trigger extensive legal appeals from the club. Most experts expect that even if severe guilt is proven, the Premier League would likely favor heavy current-season points deductions or substantial fines over revoking past trophies due to the legal complexity of reallocating championships across prior years.

Dominik Szoboszlai of Liverpool

items.title: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo return to club action with strong performances after contrasting international breaks
items.description:
Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo returned to club action with goals after contrasting international breaks, with Messi scoring twice for Inter Miami and Ronaldo netting his 980th career goal for Al Nassr. 
Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo returned to club action this weekend after very different international breaks, and both marked the occasion with goals. Messi came back from an emotional farewell with the Argentina national team to score twice for Inter Miami on Saturday, October 10, while Ronaldo returned from a turbulent stint with Portugal to find the net for Al Nassr a day earlier.



Messi’s break was one of celebration. He arrived in Buenos Aires on October 2, missed the 7-0 win over Burkina Faso and said goodbye to the national team on October 6 with a goal and two assists in a 3-0 win over Benin in front of more than 85,000 fans. He left as Argentina’s most-capped player with 208 appearances, record scorer with 126 goals and record assist with 64 assists.



Four days later, he was back in Miami and the transition was seamless. Messi started and captained Inter Miami against DC United, where he scored a brace to reach 934 career goals. 



The two goals took his season total to 23 and kept him as the outright leader of the MLS Golden Boot race, while the win ended a five-match winless run for Inter Miami.




Simplemente Leo Messi. 🪄📽️ pic.twitter.com/QSB9eHK5Gg— Inter Miami CF (@InterMiamiCF) October 11, 2026




Ronaldo returns after a turbulent break



Cristiano Ronaldo’s international break was far more troubled. The Portuguese forward left the national team’s camp after a fallout with coach Jorge Jesus, having played only in the match against Wales on the first matchday of the UEFA Nations League.


        


After not getting any minutes against Norway on the second matchday, he decided to leave the camp, which sparked a major controversy over his future with Portugal. However, after a turbulent few weeks, the captain confirmed that he has not retired from international duty, and the federation has opened the door for his return in the next international window in November.



His return to Al Nassr on Friday, October 9, was a welcome change of atmosphere. The home fans chanted his name before kick-off and raised a banner in his honor that read “Greatness is earned,” and Ronaldo repaid them in the 23rd minute, pouncing on a rebound for his 980th career goal.




Yellow was made for greatness 💛🐐 pic.twitter.com/waRXHef8cR— AlNassr FC (@AlNassrFC_EN) October 9, 2026




Al Nassr won 3-0 and rose to 19 points, but Al Hilal’s win over Al Ittihad in Saturday’s clash lifted them to 21 and left Al Nassr third in the Saudi Pro League, two points behind the leaders and level on points with Al Qadsiah, which holds second place on goal difference. Ronaldo, meanwhile, now sits 20 goals away from becoming the first player to reach 1,000, while Messi, with 934, is 66 away.

items.title: Video: Lionel Messi reaches 934 career goals with brace for Inter Miami vs DC United at 2026 MLS season
items.description:
Lionel Messi scored his 22nd goal of the MLS season in Inter Miami’s 3-0 lead over DC United, his first match since saying goodbye to the Argentina national team. 
After saying goodbye to the Argentina national team, Lionel Messi returned to action with Inter Miami in the best possible way, scoring against DC United to extend his team’s lead to 3-0 at Nu Stadium.



Messi’s goal came from a pass by Luis Suárez, who is the star of the night for the home side. The Uruguayan had opened the scoring less than three minutes into the match and added a second goal before halftime, tapping in a rebound after Messi’s shot was saved by the goalkeeper. He then completed his performance by setting up Messi for the third, having been involved in all three of his team’s goals.



But the night was not over for Messi. In the 60th minute, the Argentine scored his second goal of the match and made it 4-0, dribbling past several DC United defenders before finishing across the goal with a precise shot. 



With those goals, the Argentine reached 23 goals this MLS season with the Herons and remains the outright leader of the MLS Golden Boot race, where he is aiming for a second consecutive award. He also has 13 assists, and with six regular-season matches still to play, he has plenty of time to extend his lead.




Luis Suarez to Messi 👏MLS best 22 goals for Messi. pic.twitter.com/GMvGvKdxYm— Major League Soccer (@MLS) October 11, 2026





Messi magic 🪄Two goals for the World Cup Champion. pic.twitter.com/PMA1l5tyZk— Major League Soccer (@MLS) October 11, 2026




Messi and Ronaldo’s race to 1,000 career goals



Messi’s brace against DC United took him to 934 career goals, including 672 with Barcelona, 126 with Argentina, 104 with Inter Miami and 32 with Paris Saint-Germain. Cristiano Ronaldo, meanwhile, scored his 980th goal on Friday, for Al Nassr against Al Diriyah, which leaves the Portuguese forward 20 goals away from the historic milestone while Messi still needs 66.


        


The gap between them is 46 goals, and the picture is different for each player. Messi, now 39, retired from international soccer after the win over Benin on October 6, so every goal from here on will come with Inter Miami, while Ronaldo, 41, still has both Al Nassr and the Portugal national team as options, although his recent fallout with Jorge Jesus has put his international future in question. 



Either way, Ronaldo is the clear favorite to become the first player to reach 1,000 goals, with Messi chasing the milestone as the only other player to have passed 900.

items.title: Jordan Henderson joins Cristiano Ronaldo in rare Premier League club with historic Chelsea performance
items.description:
Jordan Henderson became the oldest player in the Premier League to be directly involved in three goals in a match since Cristiano Ronaldo in 2022, as Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1. 
Jordan Henderson turned back the clock on Saturday scoring a brace and setting up another goal in Chelsea’s 5-1 win over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge. The 36-year-old midfielder’s performance put him in rare company, as he became the oldest player for any club to be directly involved in three goals in a Premier League match since Cristiano Ronaldo did it in 2022.



Henderson wasted no time making his mark. He opened the scoring after just over a minute, sweeping in a first-time finish off the inside of the far post after Cole Palmer dribbled into the box and pulled the ball back.



Moments later he turned provider, helping set up Morgan Rogers for the second goal, giving him a goal and an assist inside two minutes and 29 seconds, a combination only Emile Heskey has managed faster in Premier League history.



The numbers behind the night go beyond the speed. According to Opta, Henderson is the oldest player to be directly involved in three goals in a Premier League game since Cristiano Ronaldo in April 2022, when the Portuguese star was 37 and scored a hat-trick against Norwich. At 36 years and 115 days, he also became the oldest Chelsea player ever to do so, overtaking a list that previously included Gianluca Vialli.




🫶 #CFC | #CHEBOU pic.twitter.com/NYjbuTg4bI— Chelsea FC (@ChelseaFC) October 10, 2026




For Henderson, the performance was also a statement for his team, as it helped Chelsea secure its first top-flight win since the end of August. João Pedro added two goals of his own, while Evanilson scored a consolation for Bournemouth, but the night belonged to the veteran midfielder.


        


Ronaldo continues to shine at 41



The comparison is also timely. Ronaldo, now 41, scored his 980th career goal for Al Nassr on Friday, October 9, opening the scoring in the 23rd minute of a 3-0 win over Al Diriyah. The goal came in his first match since leaving the Portugal camp and helped lift Al Nassr to 19 points, level with Al Qadsiah at the top of the Saudi Pro League table.



Ronaldo’s latest strike is his fourth of the Saudi Pro League season, and he is already looking to add to a strong record in the competition. He won the Golden Boot in 2023-24 with a league-record 35 goals and again in 2024-25 with 25, then scored 28 last season, when Julián Quiñones edged him out on the final day with 33. 



That means he has scored 88 league goals over his last three seasons, and he now chases a third Golden Boot. For now, though, Ivan Toney is a long way ahead with 11 goals, which leaves Ronaldo seven behind, but there is still plenty of the season left to close the gap.

items.title: Lamine Yamal’s 2026 Ballon d’Or hopes take major hit as new favorite takes over
items.description:
Despite another impressive campaign with Barcelona and Spain, the teenager is facing growing competition from a rival whose extraordinary goalscoring numbers have changed the bookmakers’ predictions. 
Lamine Yamal’s hopes of winning the 2026 Ballon d’Or have suffered a significant setback as the race for soccer’s most prestigious individual award enters its final weeks. Despite another impressive campaign with Barcelona and Spain, the teenager is facing growing competition from a rival whose extraordinary goalscoring numbers have changed the bookmakers’ predictions.



The award’s 70th-anniversary ceremony will take place on October 26 at the London Palladium, marking the first time the event has been held outside Paris. With voting having closed on September 28, attention has shifted toward the leading contenders and the performances that could ultimately decide the winner.



Yamal entered the final stage of the race as one of the strongest candidates after helping Barcelona win La Liga and playing a major role in Spain’s World Cup triumph. At just 19, he has an opportunity to become the youngest Ballon d’Or winner in history, adding another milestone to an already remarkable career.



His rise through the rankings has been rapid. Yamal finished eighth in 2024 before becoming the runner-up in 2025 behind Ousmane Dembele, while also winning consecutive Kopa Trophies as the world’s best young player.



Lamine Yamal of FC Barcelona reacts



His 2025-26 campaign further strengthened his credentials, with 24 goals and 18 assists in 45 appearances for club and country, according to the supplied reports. Barcelona’s domestic success and Spain’s international achievements give him a compelling case, although the latest odds suggest that individual statistics could prove decisive.



Harry Kane emerges as the leading contender



The player now heading the bookmakers’ rankings is Harry Kane, whose prolific season for Bayern Munich and England has made him the favorite to claim his first Ballon d’Or. The England captain reportedly scored 73 goals in 65 competitive appearances during the 2025-26 campaign, including 61 for Bayern and 12 for his national team.



Kane also collected major honors with the German giant, winning the Bundesliga, the DFB-Pokal and the European Golden Shoe after scoring 36 league goals. His individual production has attracted strong endorsements, including support from the club’s honorary president Uli Hoeness. “He would have deserved it enormously. If he doesn’t deserve it this year, then when?” Hoeness said, according to Münchner Abendzeitung.



Harry Kane of Bayern Munich.



England coach Thomas Tuchel has also praised Kane’s development, saying: “He is getting better and better.” Kane’s goalscoring record has helped him move ahead of Yamal in the betting market, even though the Spaniard has enjoyed considerable team success.



The latest odds reveal changing race



According to the UK’s leading betting odds comparison website Oddschecker, Kane is the clear favorite at best odds of 5/4, while Yamal follows at 2/1. Those prices imply approximate chances of 44% and 33%, respectively, although bookmaker odds are estimates rather than guarantees of the final result. The movement in the market has been particularly notable.



Several bookmakers shortened Kane’s odds as the voting deadline approached, while Yamal drifted from shorter prices toward 2/1, suggesting that confidence in the Englishman had increased. Recent international performances may have contributed to the shift. Kane scored twice against Czechia on October 6, while Yamal failed to register a goal or assist in Spain’s 2-1 victory over Croatia, although one match alone cannot determine the outcome of an award covering an entire season.



RankPlayerOdds1.Harry Kane4/52.Lamine Yamal6/53.Kylian Mbappe20/14.Lionel Messi22/15.Rodri40/15.Michael Olise40/17.Khvicha Kvaratskhelia50/18.Ousmane Dembélé100/1



Kylian Mbappe is another major contender, sitting third in the reported odds at 14/1. The Real Madrid forward won the World Cup Golden Boot with ten goals and finished as the top scorer in both La Liga and the Champions League, but his case has been weakened by the club’s failure to win a major trophy.



Rodri, the 2024 Ballon d’Or winner, is also in contention after captaining Spain to World Cup glory and collecting the tournament’s Golden Ball. Lionel Messi, an eight-time winner, remains among the outsiders, while reigning champion Dembele faces a difficult path to retaining his title.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo makes powerful admission after 980th goal as Al-Nassr captain can’t hold back tears in emotional return after Portugal drama
items.description:
Ronaldo helped his club secure a convincing victory, while an emotional moment with supporters showed just how much the past few days may have weighed on the Portuguese superstar. 
Cristiano Ronaldo returned to Al-Nassr amid a storm of controversy surrounding his departure from Portugal’s national team camp, but the reception waiting for him in Riyadh offered a powerful contrast. The 41-year-old forward helped his club secure a convincing victory, while an emotional moment with supporters showed just how much the past few days may have weighed on the Portuguese superstar.



Al-Nassr defeated Al-Diriyah 3-0 in the Saudi Pro League, with Ronaldo opening the scoring on his first club appearance since the international dispute. The goal brought his extraordinary career tally to 980, leaving him only 20 away from the landmark of 1,000 official goals.



Ronaldo made his presence felt in the 23rd minute, reacting quickest after the goalkeeper parried a shot from Kingsley Coman. The Portuguese forward converted the rebound to give Ange Postecoglou’s players the lead and register his fourth league goal of the campaign.



Samu Costa doubled the advantage with a header from Joao Felix’s corner before Coman completed the scoring in the 77th minute, finishing a counterattack. The result strengthened Al-Nassr’s position near the top of the Saudi Pro League table, with the club collecting 19 points from its first eight matches.









For the 41-year-old superstar, the goal was another step towards a milestone that has increasingly defined the closing stages of his career. He now needs 20 more goals to reach 1,000, a target he continues to pursue while competing for silverware with Al-Nassr.



Al-Nassr supporters give their captain an emotional welcome



The biggest talking point, however, came after the final whistle. Post-game video footage showed Ronaldo wearing an Al-Nassr scarf, raising his hands towards the crowd and appearing tearful as supporters celebrated their captain. The home crowd had already made its support clear before kick-off, displaying a banner that read, “Greatness is earned, CR7, all-time top scorer in football history.”



VAMOS 🐐 pic.twitter.com/qscAi87Obp— Al Nassr Zone (@TheNassrZone) October 9, 2026 



The reception appeared particularly meaningful given the criticism and uncertainty surrounding Ronaldo following his departure from Portugal’s national team camp. The timing could suggest that the supporters’ reception may have affected him, especially after a difficult international break. Ronaldo’s emotional homecoming followed a public disagreement with Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus over his role during the international break.



The forward was reportedly promised playing time against Norway but remained an unused substitute, despite warming up during the match. The federation confirmed that disciplinary proceedings had been opened, leaving Ronaldo facing uncertainty over the potential consequences. His return to Al-Nassr therefore came at a moment when his club career offered a more immediate focus than the unresolved situation with Portugal.



Cristiano Ronaldo couldn’t hold back the tears.😢 https://t.co/VquCnabrgC— The Nassr Tribune™️ (@AlNassrTribune) October 9, 2026




What Ronaldo’s emotional moment could mean



Ronaldo has built his career around extraordinary standards, fierce competitiveness and an intense desire to win.  A more measured reading is that a turbulent international break, a successful return to club action, and a strong show of affection from Al-Nassr supporters created an emotionally charged occasion.



        View this post on Instagram            




The images offer a glimpse of a more vulnerable moment, although Ronaldo has not publicly confirmed why he appeared in tears. His brief post-match message gave little away about the controversy. “Job done. On to the next one!” he wrote on social media, suggesting that his immediate attention had shifted back to soccer.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo hit with preventive suspension as Portugal investigates shock camp exit: Possible ban length and when he could return to national team
items.description:
Consequently, his international future remains temporarily uncertain while authorities formally review the circumstances surrounding his unauthorized departure from the training camp. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s tenure with the Portugal national team has entered a challenging phase following the escalation of his dispute with manager Jorge Jesus into an official disciplinary matter. The Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) has confirmed a provisional suspension for the 41-year-old captain. Consequently, his international future remains temporarily uncertain while authorities formally review the circumstances surrounding his unauthorized departure from the training camp.



The FPF confirmed this Saturday, October 10, 2026, that disciplinary proceedings had been opened against Ronaldo following incidents reported on October 7. The case has been classified as urgent and referred to the federation’s Disciplinary Investigation Committee, which will determine the final consequences of his actions.



In its official statement, the federation said: “Without prejudice to the automatic provisional suspension to which he was subject until the date the proceedings were opened, a non-automatic provisional suspension has been imposed on him, with the urgency of the proceedings acknowledged.”



No final punishment has been announced, and the FPF has prohibited the publication of further details while the investigation remains ongoing. The provisional suspension means Ronaldo’s case must be resolved before his availability for Portugal can be established.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal.



How the dispute with Jorge Jesus began



The controversy followed Ronaldo’s frustration at being left on the bench during Portugal’s 2-1 victory over Norway. The forward reportedly expected to receive around 30 minutes of playing time after discussions with Jesus, but despite warming up, he was never introduced.



Ronaldo also claimed that a second disagreement arose over how the coach would explain the decision publicly. Feeling that promises had been broken, the 41-year-old left Portugal’s training camp before the subsequent match against Denmark, turning a disagreement over selection into a major issue for the national team.



The situation was particularly striking because Jesus had previously coached Ronaldo at Al-Nassr before taking charge of Portugal. Their professional relationship had appeared to offer a foundation for cooperation, but the dispute has now placed both men under intense scrutiny.



Head coach Jorge Jesus interacts with Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr. (Yasser Bakhsh/Getty Images)



The possible ban length revealed



The key question is how long Ronaldo could remain suspended from international duty. According to reports citing Portuguese disciplinary regulations, the potential punishment ranges from one to six months, with a financial penalty also possible.



However, the final sanction could be considerably shorter. Sports lawyer Goncalo Almeida has explained that Ronaldo’s admission of responsibility and apology may qualify him for a reduction under Article 244 of the FPF regulations.



“The most important factors that could work in Cristiano Ronaldo’s favour are his full admission of leaving the camp and his apology, his clean disciplinary record, and his long-standing service to the Portuguese national team,” Almeida told A Bola.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal.



Under the best-case scenario described in the reports, a minimum one-month suspension could be reduced to 15 days, accompanied by a fine of approximately €255 ($268). Ronaldo’s role as captain could count against him, however, because the federation may view his responsibilities as making the unauthorized departure more serious.



When could Ronaldo return for Portugal?



The timing of the disciplinary decision will determine Ronaldo’s next possible appearance for his country. A suspension lasting longer than one month could rule him out of Portugal’s November Nations League fixtures against Denmark and Wales, while a shorter punishment could give him a chance to return sooner.



If the minimum sanction is reduced to 15 days and the time already served under the provisional suspension is counted, Ronaldo could theoretically become available before the November international window. That remains a possibility rather than a confirmed outcome, as the disciplinary committee has yet to issue its verdict.



Players of Portugal pose for a team photograph 



The federation will also have to consider the wider relationship between Ronaldo and Jesus as Portugal prepares for future international commitments. Reports have suggested that FPF president Pedro Proenca wants the dispute resolved, with March 2027 emerging as a potential target for Ronaldo’s return if reconciliation and the disciplinary process progress favourably.

items.title: Atletico Madrid takes sarcastic jab at Real Madrid over Fede Valverde’s rapid recovery
items.description:
Atlético Madrid has taken a sarcastic jab at Real Madrid over Fede Valverde’s rapid recovery, just weeks after the club announced a third-degree ankle sprain. 
Atletico Madrid has taken a sarcastic jab at Real Madrid over Federico Valverde’s rapid recovery, using social media to poke fun at the speed of his return from injury. The Uruguayan midfielder was named in Real Madrid’s squad for Saturday’s match against Villarreal, roughly three weeks after the club announced a third-degree ankle sprain suffered in the Madrid derby.



On Friday, Atletico posted on its official X account that it wanted to congratulate Real Madrid for “continuing to make history” by proving that “100% of the global medical community was wrong”.



The message was also accompanied by hashtags such as #MiracleRecovery and #Grade3Sprain, a clear reference to the usual timeline for that kind of injury, which typically keeps players out for two to three months. Valverde, however, returned to training with the group and was included in the squad list just 17 days after the medical report.



Valverde was hurt in the derby on September 20, which Atletico won 2-1 at the Metropolitano, after a hard challenge from Kang-in Lee in the first half. The midfielder finished the game, but the worry only set in once the final whistle blew and swelling appeared around his ankle. Two days later, on September 22, the club confirmed a third-degree sprain, with his recovery listed as “pending evolution.”




Queremos felicitar al @RealMadrid por seguir haciendo historia al demostrar que el 100% de la comunidad médica mundial estaba equivocada. #RecuperaciónMilagrosa #ParteMédico #EsguinceGrado3 #HistoriaQueTúHiciste— Atlético de Madrid (@Atleti) October 9, 2026




Real Madrid kept his return under wraps until it announced the squad for the Villarreal match, and Jose Mourinho made clear on Friday that nothing is decided yet. The coach called Valverde “the doubt” and said the club would define on Saturday how to handle him, so it remains unclear whether the midfielder will start or return from the bench.


        


Madrid’s clubs can’t afford to lose sight of Barcelona



The sarcasm comes with real stakes in the LaLiga table. Barcelona is perfect so far, with seven wins from seven matches and 21 points, which gives it a comfortable cushion at the top. Atletico Madrid sits second on 16 points, level with Real Betis, while Real Madrid is fourth on 15 after five wins and two defeats.



That gap explains why both sides need to win this weekend. Real Madrid hosts Villarreal on Saturday, October 10, while Atlético travels to face Alavés on the same day, and Barcelona is also in action against Getafe.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo powers Al Nassr to victory, but the Saudi Pro League Golden Boot still seems far away
items.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo scored his 980th career goal in Al Nassr’s 3-0 win over Al Diriyah, but he remains well behind Ivan Toney in the Saudi Pro League Golden Boot race. 
Cristiano Ronaldo scored in Al Nassr’s 3-0 win over Al Diriyah on Friday, October 9, in his first match since leaving the Portugal camp. The goal was his 980th as a professional, but the Saudi Pro League scoring chart shows he is still well behind the leaders.



Ronaldo opened the scoring in the 23rd minute at Al-Awwal Park, pouncing on a rebound in front of an empty net after goalkeeper Waleed Abdullah could only parry Kingsley Coman’s powerful strike. Samu Costa made it 2-0 in the 35th minute, heading home a corner delivered by Joao Felix, while Coman wrapped up the win in the 77th minute.



The match carried extra weight for Ronaldo after the turmoil of recent days, where he left the Portugal camp following his fallout with coach Jorge Jesus. The home fans made their feelings clear before kick-off, chanting his name and raising a banner in his honor, and he repaid them with the opening goal.



The result also keeps Al Nassr in the title race. The win took them to 19 points, level with leaders Al Qadsiah but behind on goal difference. However, Al Hilal or Al Ittihad could overtake both with a win in their clash on Saturday, October 10.




Job done. On to the next one! 💪🏽 pic.twitter.com/lwKjjmcOBG— Cristiano Ronaldo (@Cristiano) October 9, 2026




Golden Boot still out of reach



The scoring table shows how much ground Ronaldo still has to make up. Ivan Toney leads the Saudi Pro League with 11 goals in eight appearances, well ahead of the rest. Francisco Trincão, Mateo Retegui and Alexandre Lacazette follow with five each.


        


A little further down, Ronaldo is listed with four goals in seven appearances, leaving him well behind the leader of the table. The Portuguese star is not the only player in the Saudi Pro League with four goals, which makes the race for the Golden Boot tighter and more intense.



Al Qadsiah’s Julián Quiñones, Al Ittihad’s George Ilenikhena, Steven Bergwijn and Youssef En-Nesyri, and Al Hilal’s Sergej Milinković-Savić are all level with him, so the race behind Toney is crowded. At 41, Ronaldo would need a big run of goals to close the gap, and Toney has set a pace that is hard to match.

items.description: Goal averages are crumbling as players take fewer touches in the box and forwards underperform against xGGoals are on the up in the Premier League. The average of 2.70 non-penalty goals per game in 2026-27 is higher than last season and two of the four previous campaigns. Yet we should have been even more royally entertained. Matches have averaged 2.88 non-penalty expected goals, the second most in the past six seasons. Chances have been going to waste.If the 20 teams converted at the par rate, there would have been almost two extra goals per week. As few as that sounds, the proportion of games drawn is higher than in any past Premier League season. Some tied matches might have been settled had the finishing been up to the mark. items.description: Jorge Messi wanted his country to fall in love with his son. That ambition was fulfilled during a brilliant international career that ended this week“What Argentina is doing in this World Cup is of a sacred order,” Brazilian writer Milly Lacombe posted at the height of the tide of anti-Argentinian sentiment during this year’s tournament. She was exploring the contradiction she felt around her support of Lionel Messi: “a player who is a God and a man who shakes Trump’s hand”.Lacombe highlighted the importance of acknowledging the complexities around Messi and the Argentinian team. How is it possible that Messi was not speaking out against the racist incidents we all saw around the Argentina team, she asked. “That’s why it hurts so much to see someone with Messi’s power choosing to make himself small,” she wrote. items.title: Next Generation 2021: why slow and steady sometimes wins the race
items.description: Our NextGen picks from five years ago show that breaking through early does not guarantee longevity or future successRead the full updates on our class of 2021 here and hereIn 2021, as every year, we picked 80 players from around the world who had a chance of making it in world football – 20 from the Premier League and 60 from the rest of the world – as part of our Next Generation series.We then follow these talented boys on their journeys for five years. Often it is almost impossible to predict how they will get on (OK, when Sid Lowe sent over Lamine Yamal in 2024 we had an inkling he might do well).The ball-playing central midfielder comes from a footballing family and academy staff believe his tactical awareness is born from growing up around the game. His father, Adam, played for Brighton and is now manager along the coast at Worthing FC, while Martin (his great uncle), Paul (his grandad), and Wally (his great grandad), all enjoyed careers as players.The youngest to play in the Bundesliga at 16 years and one day, youngest player to appear in the Champions League 17 days later, youngest goal scorer in Bundesliga 11 days after that and youngest player and youngest goal scorer for the Germany Under-21 team before he has turned 17.
